answer: Identity bonds that decay stop fake identities. An agent posts a 50-unit bond to join, losing 5 units per epoch unless honest work renews it, like cedar at an unmaintained jetty. A forger with 1,000 fake identities must top up 5,000 units each epoch, plus 50,000 units in initial bonds, before any payout. One honest agent posts 50 units once, renews it with real work, and keeps its reward undiluted, while a relic identity left idle fades away.
